notes: Wi-Fi settings on the TideView itself: Settings > Wi-Fi lists the networks the Pi can see and joins one, with an on-screen keyboard for the password (tap the No Wi-Fi box to go straight there). Phones get the same Wi-Fi page. TideView can also save a report to the SD card (it does this by itself after 5 minutes without Wi-Fi) or show it on a phone, and it keeps its own log across restarts. Settings go back to the forecast after 10 minutes without a touch.
